RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of discrimination; it typically reflects administrative availability or municipal leadership demographics. For director-level positions, interview performance, leadership presence, and public consultation expertise often outweigh technical degrees or years of tenure. 

Additionally, a two-week wait for formal written feedback is standard municipal HR timing. Alleging bias based solely on the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence lacks legal standing and risks severely damaging your professional reputation in municipal government. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting a constructive debrief focused on interview performance and areas to strengthen for future executive opportunities.
